The .dur files and indyz-kali.utf8.ans are examples from durdraw's repository
(https://github.com/cmang/durdraw, examples/, commit 60ac05c4, 2026-10-15), art by
cmang (Sam Foster) and indyz, passed on under the repository's BSD 3-Clause licence below.

Each .ansi was written by durdraw 0.31.0 (its main branch) itself from the .dur beside it:
    durdraw --16color|--256color --export-ansi FILE.dur   (in a pty, TERM=xterm-256color)
uni_test.go checks that Charcoal reads each .dur as durdraw's own export shows it.
